blog_title: MRP Tag Missing on Flipkart Orders — How 800 T-Shirts Got Rejected Over ₹8 Packaging Mistake
caption:
₹8 tag missing. 800 t-shirts rejected. ₹50,000 loss. 😬

A Flipkart seller nailed the print quality, sourced 800 blanks, perfect shipment ready. Then the warehouse said no — MRP tag wasn't attached. Just ₹8 each. Entire order rejected. Freight + penalties wiped out the margin.

The lesson? Before bulk orders hit the warehouse, lock down your checklist: MRP, wash care label, size tag, barcode. That ₹8 investment saves ₹50k headaches.

Save this if you're scaling your printing business 👇
